in_sanskrit.name: अरविन्द
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who shines like the sun.

in_marathi.name: Aravindhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aravindhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aravindhan is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name, where 'Aravind' means 'radiant' and 'han' means 'one'. This name is often associated with the Sun God, Indra, and Lord Vishnu, symbolizing power, brilliance, and divinity.
